component.name: YT Musicfast
component.summary: A fast, native app for YouTube Music

description.p: YT Musicfast plays YouTube Music in a light, native app instead of a browser tab.

ul.li: Your mixes, Liked Music, playlists and history, in step with your phone and the website
Search, Home and Explore, albums, artists and charts
Songs and music videos, synced lyrics and an editable queue
Media keys and your desktop's media controls

description.p: An independent project, not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Google or YouTube. It uses YouTube Music's private web API, which can change without notice.
The first version for Windows and Linux.
